title.zh_cn: 一张卡：16 台满载加工

text.en_us: A full one-card setup: 16 Deployers, each with its own Depot and Sand Paper. Connected shafts through each row are powered by the motor at its end.
text.zh_cn: 一张卡的满载阵列：16 台机械手，各有独立料盘和砂纸。每排机械手的 X 向转轴相连，由末端马达供动力。

text.en_us: Before installing a card, only the machine directly east of the provider can receive work: 1/1 active machine. The other 15 stay empty.
text.zh_cn: 未装卡时，仅供应器东侧紧邻的机械手能接收任务：当前 1/1 台工作，其余 15 台保持空闲。

text.en_us: Select the provider with the Machine Linker, then right-click all 15 extra Deployers. The front machine is already counted; it is not a seventeenth target.
text.zh_cn: 用链接器选中供应器，再逐一右键其余 15 台机械手。正面机器已计入总数，不要把一张卡理解成额外增加 16 台。

text.en_us: Install card 1/1 by sneak-right-clicking, or use an upgrade slot. The current limit is 16 total machines.
text.zh_cn: 潜行右键安装第 1/1 张并行卡，或放入升级槽。当前容量为 16 台，包含正面机器。

text.en_us: Full load: 16/16. ME supplies 16 separate jobs and enough Rose Quartz. Every machine receives an input at the same moment and processes it with its own held tool.
text.zh_cn: 满载 16/16：ME 提供 16 份独立任务与足量玫瑰石英，全部机器同时收到原料，再使用各自的手持工具加工。

text.en_us: All 16 products are collected from the 16 individual working positions and returned to ME. The provider connection shown still needs powered storage, a channel and a crafting CPU with enough parallel work.
text.zh_cn: 16 份成品从各自工作位回到 ME。图中仅示意供应器的接网位置，实际还需有电存储、可用频道，以及能提供足够并行任务的合成 CPU。

text.en_us: Cards increase available machine slots, not output per recipe or rotational power. One card caps at 16, four at 64, including the front machine. Fewer valid links means fewer active machines.
text.zh_cn: 并行卡增加机器槽位，不提高单次配方产量，也不提供动力。一卡最多 16 台、四卡最多 64 台，均含正面机器；有效目标不足时不会凭空补足。

title.zh_cn: 四张卡：64 台满载加工

text.en_us: Four-card maximum: a real 8 by 8 array of 64 Deployers. Each row has its own connected motor; each machine has a separate Depot and Sand Paper.
text.zh_cn: 四张卡的容量上限：8×8，共 64 台机械手。每排均有相连马达，每台都有独立料盘与砂纸。

text.en_us: Use the previous linking procedure for all 63 extra machines. The front machine plus these links makes exactly 64 targets. Keep every target loaded and use the same machine block type.
text.zh_cn: 按前段操作选中供应器，绑定另外 63 台同类型机器。正面 1 台加链接 63 台，正好 64 台；所有目标都要保持加载。

text.en_us: Install card 1/4 by sneak-right-clicking, or use an upgrade slot. The current limit is 16 total machines.
text.zh_cn: 潜行右键安装第 1/4 张并行卡，或放入升级槽。当前容量为 16 台，包含正面机器。

text.en_us: Install card 2/4 by sneak-right-clicking, or use an upgrade slot. The current limit is 32 total machines.
text.zh_cn: 潜行右键安装第 2/4 张并行卡，或放入升级槽。当前容量为 32 台，包含正面机器。

text.en_us: Install card 3/4 by sneak-right-clicking, or use an upgrade slot. The current limit is 48 total machines.
text.zh_cn: 潜行右键安装第 3/4 张并行卡，或放入升级槽。当前容量为 48 台，包含正面机器。

text.en_us: Install card 4/4 by sneak-right-clicking, or use an upgrade slot. The current limit is 64 total machines.
text.zh_cn: 潜行右键安装第 4/4 张并行卡，或放入升级槽。当前容量为 64 台，包含正面机器。

text.en_us: Full load: 64/64. ME supplies 64 separate jobs and enough Rose Quartz. Every machine receives an input at the same moment and processes it with its own held tool.
text.zh_cn: 满载 64/64：ME 提供 64 份独立任务与足量玫瑰石英，全部机器同时收到原料，再使用各自的手持工具加工。

text.en_us: All 64 products are collected from the 64 individual working positions and returned to ME. The provider connection shown still needs powered storage, a channel and a crafting CPU with enough parallel work.
text.zh_cn: 64 份成品从各自工作位回到 ME。图中仅示意供应器的接网位置，实际还需有电存储、可用频道，以及能提供足够并行任务的合成 CPU。

text.en_us: Cards increase available machine slots, not output per recipe or rotational power. One card caps at 16, four at 64, including the front machine. Fewer valid links means fewer active machines.
text.zh_cn: 并行卡增加机器槽位，不提高单次配方产量，也不提供动力。一卡最多 16 台、四卡最多 64 台，均含正面机器；有效目标不足时不会凭空补足。

title.zh_cn: 高级分发器增加的是作业上限

text.en_us: Parallel Cards also fit Advanced Package Distributors. With no card, the distributor accepts 1 active assembly job across its routed patterns.
text.zh_cn: 并行卡也支持高级封包分发器。无卡时，分发器在所存机械路线样板中最多运行 1 个序列装配作业。

text.en_us: By default, 1 card allows 16 active jobs and 4 allow 64. The server can set 1-64 jobs per card; this setting does not change Kinetic Providers' fixed 16 machines per card.
text.zh_cn: 默认 1 卡允许 16 作业，4 卡允许 64。服务端可配每卡 1–64 作业；该配置不改变动力供应器固定的每卡 16 台机器。

text.en_us: Actual parallel work needs independent, powered assembly lines and a routed pattern for each. Any shared route position blocks concurrent use, including a shared input or output.
text.zh_cn: 实际并行还需各自有动力和运输设施的独立装配线，以及各自的路线样板。共享任一路线坐标都不能同时占用，包括共用输入或输出。

text.en_us: Two usable independent routes can run at most two jobs, even with a 16-job card. A card does not clone a route, build transport, or supply machine power.
text.zh_cn: 只有两条可用独立路线时，即使装了 16 作业卡，也最多同时运行两条。卡不会复制路线、建立运输或提供动力。
